title: Chapter 2685 - 81: Wood Revitalization Formation (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 2685: Chapter 81: Wood Revitalization Formation (Part 2)

Some severely injured barbarian soldiers even began to feel cold in their limbs, gradually nearing the brink of death.

Chi Feng approached a wounded man, dipped his finger in the blood on the man’s wound, sniffed it at the tip of his nose, and his face darkened immensely:

"Bloodfang poison."

Bloodfang poison is a rather rare poisonous herb found in the Barbaric Wilderness, containing intense toxicity. Once it enters the body of a cultivator, it feels like being bitten by the teeth of a monster beast, causing continuous bleeding, hence the name "Bloodfang."

Until the blood is exhausted, the poison will not dissipate.

Elder Ba Shan angrily said, "Damn it, these birdmen of the Bi Fang Tribe are truly beasts!"

In tribal warfare, unless there is a deep blood feud, it’s generally not worth the effort to smear such despicable poison on weapons.

The key is that this Blood Tooth Grass is extremely rare and not something that can be casually obtained.

Even if one obtains it, they would generally be reluctant to use it lightly.

Using Bloodfang poison often means that one has made a ruthless decision, determined not to rest until death.

Chi Feng’s eyes were filled with anger, "Looks like that boy Bi Jie has gone mad, bent on fighting us to the bitter end."

Dan Zhu looked extremely grave, but with his compassionate nature, he was more worried about these wounded Danque Tribe barbarian soldiers.

This was his first expedition.

These barbarian soldiers were the first squad he truly led personally.

He did not want these soldiers to die here.

Feeling self-blame in his heart, Dan Zhu asked Chi Feng, "Master Chi Feng, is there a way to cure the Bloodfang poison?"

Chi Feng’s expression was solemn: "The only option is to replenish blood, continuously replenish blood, to compensate for the depletion of Blood Qi. Otherwise, we can only endure it, but the problem is, too many people are injured, medicines are not enough, and casualties will only increase..."

Chi Feng understood that Bi Jie’s move was to incapacitate the Danque Tribe soldiers’ "self-healing" ability with poison.

The elite soldiers of the Danque Tribe numbered only just over a hundred. Over time, at best, they would become critically injured from blood loss, and at worst, they could die from blood exhaustion. Eventually, they would simply be "worn out" by the poison.

Once the casualties were too high, they would become the fish meat on the chopping block for the Bi Fang Tribe.

"Bi Jie, the young master of the Bi Fang Tribe, is despicable and ruthless, stopping at nothing to achieve his goals. No wonder the Great Chief of the Bi Fang Tribe holds him in such high regard."

"Once Bi Jie becomes the Great Chief in the future, the Bi Fang Tribe will inevitably become a serious threat to the Danque Tribe."

Chi Feng’s expression was grave, and he sighed slowly.

Dan Zhu also frowned deeply, but due to his lack of experience, he thought for a long time but still could do nothing, habitually turning his head to look at Mo Hua.

"Mr. Witch..."

Mr. Witch, with his vast divine skills, might have a solution.

Mo Hua sighed lightly in his heart.

Seeing the Danque Tribe soldiers, everyone bloody and severely wounded, Mo Hua also felt distressed.

These hundred elite soldiers, although considered Dan Zhu’s "posse."

Conversely, they also constituted his effective forces for implementing his plans.

They were all "his people." Now seeing that as many as thirty or forty elite soldiers were bleeding ceaselessly and their injuries were worsening, Mo Hua was a bit anxious too.

If all these elite troops were to die from blood loss, the loss would be significant.

His previous plans would all need to be completely overturned.

Moreover, once casualties increased, the Danque Tribe would inevitably be unable to defend the Shugubu’s military supplies.

If these military supplies were snatched by the Bi Fang Tribe, preventing the forging of superior barbarian armor, further arming the soldiers, and strengthening their forces, plans for external conquest would have to be postponed temporarily.

The progress of Core Formation would be further delayed.

This was something Mo Hua could not tolerate.

But he was not a Pill Master, nor had he ever engaged in "healing and saving lives."

Back in the Taixu Gate, his highest achievement in alchemy was only achieving "Grade C."

The pill furnace even exploded several times.

If it were an injury related to divine thought, he might still come up with some method.

But for injuries to the flesh, Mo Hua was truly helpless.

Mo Hua sighed, "I also..."

Before he finished speaking, he suddenly froze, having thought of something.

Dan Zhu looked at Mo Hua, dazed.

Mo Hua also glanced at Dan Zhu and slowly said, "I... need to consult the Divine Lord before I know if they can be saved."

Everyone was a bit astonished.

Could such matters even be consulted with the Divine Lord on the spot?

Was the Divine Lord too fond of this Mr. Witch?

"Wait here," Mo Hua said.

Everyone nodded.

Dan Zhu said solemnly, "It’s troublesome for you, Mr."

"Mm." Mo Hua nodded slightly, then left the group, entered a nearby enclosed stone chamber, and took out a box from the Storage Ring.

The box was marked as "First in the Qianxue Debate," "Gift from Dao Court," "Awarded by Tian Shu Pavilion."

Inside the box, a Jade Slip was sealed.

Recorded within the Jade Slip was a set of Formation Diagrams, named:

Wood Revitalization Formation.

This was a reward given by the Dao Court Tian Shu Pavilion to the sect that was first in the Qianxue Debate.

The ancient Jade Slip contained a complete set of Wood-type Medical Formation inheritances from First Grade to Fourth-grade.

In the inheritance of the Daoist Court Nine Provinces, due to their singular application, narrow category, and inconvenient composition, these ancient Medical Formations were gradually phased out by the flourishing Alchemy Dao, turning them into an esoteric spell point within the Formations field.

However, under the current circumstances, this Medical Formation happened to come in handy.

The Barbaric Wilderness had harsh conditions and backward levels of the Alchemy Dao.

Bloodfang poison would cause a person’s Blood Qi to continuously deplete.

With many injured people and not enough blood-replenishing pills, even medicinal herbs for healing were scarce.

The Wood Revitalization Formation perfectly compensated for these deficiencies.

This is a Medical Formation, requiring no superior Alchemy Furnace, no pills, no medicinal herbs, no Spiritual Liquid, no flame refining, and no advanced alchemy skills.
